resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register names the MFC as administrator and also says the site is no longer used by the MFC. The record reports both lines and does not settle who runs the site now.
The register gives 570 ft (174 m). OpenStreetMap's ele tag gives 171 m. The story uses the register's figure.

sources.title: The Aermotor Company: From Windmills to Forest Lookout Towers

notes_for_editor: The NHLR entry is short and undated and the only source on this tower's status. The register's administrator line and its no-longer-used line conflict, and the story reports both rather than choosing one. The LS-40 stair detail comes from a general article on Aermotor models, not from documents about this tower. The 100 ft height is converted to 30.5 m. No build date, staffing or fire history was found after two searches and about four page reads. The Forest Lookouts Mississippi index lists an Oak Hill entry but shows no county beside it, so it is not cited.
